Du trägst einen ganzen Praxis-Bereich der Steuerberatung: Strategie, Output, Aufbau und Wachstum in vollem Umfang. Du bist Eskalations-Endpunkt für deinen Bereich und eskalierst nur, was firmenstrategische Bedeutung hat. Die Bereichsstrategie entwickelst du eigenständig und bringst deine Themen aktiv in die Unternehmensstrategie ein.

Was du verantwortest

Bereich und Wachstum

  • Verantworte einen eigenständigen Praxis-Bereich oder Standort in vollem Umfang, von der Strategie über den Output bis zum Beitrag zum Geschäftsergebnis.

  • Entwickle die Bereichsstrategie eigenständig und bring deine Themen in die Unternehmensstrategie ein.

  • Treib das Wachstum über eigene Akquise, die Zusammenarbeit über alle Vogel-Bereiche und die fachliche Anbindung übernommener Mandatsstämme.

Führung der Linie

  • Führ eine eigene Führungslinie über mehrere Teams, drei bis fünf Menschen auf Bereichs-Niveau, mit tiefer indirekter Verantwortung für die Portfolios darunter.

  • Trag die volle Personalverantwortung deines Bereichs: Einstellungen im mehrstufigen Vogel-Prozess, Entwicklung deiner Senior Manager, Leistung und, wo nötig, Trennung.

  • Setz die fachlichen Standards und die Methodik deines Bereichs. Du bist Methoden-Autorität und bleibst operativ kompetent.

Mandanten und Markt

  • Bleib persönlicher Ansprechpartner für die strategisch wichtigsten Mandanten und Inhaber deines Portfolios.

  • Repräsentier Vogel nach außen, in Netzwerken, in der Branchenöffentlichkeit und in Verbänden, und bau die Reputation deines Bereichs auf.

  • Setz Impulse für unsere Positionierung, statt auf sie zu warten.

Fragen, auf die du die Antwort findest

  • Welcher Zuschnitt macht aus deinem Bereich mehr als die Summe seiner Portfolios?

  • Wie viel eigenes Mandat brauchst du, um deine Linie noch beurteilen zu können, ohne sie zu blockieren?

  • Ein übernommenes Haus bringt einen eigenen fachlichen Stil mit. Was vereinheitlichst du, und was übernimmst du von dort?

Woran wir Erfolg messen

  • Nach 6 Monaten: Du trägst deinen Bereich eigenständig, die Linie läuft über dich, ohne dass die Geschäftsführung in den Standardbetrieb eingreift. Deine Senior Manager hast du in dein Team integriert und eine eigene Wachstumslinie vorgelegt.

  • Nach 12 Monaten: Dein Bereich wächst messbar, über Akquise, bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und angebundene Mandatsstämme. Du hast deine Führungslinie weiterentwickelt und auf Bereichs-Ebene eingestellt.

  • Nach 24 Monaten: Dein Bereich trägt einen erkennbaren, eigenständigen Beitrag zum Geschäftsergebnis, die fachlichen Standards sind gesetzt und nach außen ist Reputation aufgebaut.

  • Wohin es führt: in die unternehmerische Verantwortung für eine ganze strategische Säule samt Mitverantwortung für die Unternehmensstrategie. Das ist die Management-Karriere in ihrer konsequenten Form, entschieden am Beitrag und nicht am Berufsjahr.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast das Steuerberater-Examen bestanden und danach auf Bereichs-Ebene geführt: eine Sub-Organisation, mehrere Teams oder einen Standort.

  • Du hast einen Bereich nicht nur geführt, sondern wachsen lassen, mit nachweisbarem Beitrag zu Output und Ergebnis.

  • Du hast Führungskräfte geführt, fachliche Standards gesetzt und Personalverantwortung in der Tiefe getragen.

  • Du beherrschst die Mechanik eines Tax-Geschäfts, von der Mandatsführung über die Auslastung bis zum Ergebnis, und steuerst sie über mehrere Teams.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Hebel und treibst die Automatisierung deines Bereichs, statt sie abzuwarten.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, begegnest mittelständischen Inhabern auf Augenhöhe und setzt für dich und deine Linie den höchsten Standard, weil Mittelmaß für dich keine Option ist.

Ein Plus, keine Bedingung

  • Erfahrung mit der Anbindung eines übernommenen Hauses an eine bestehende Linie.

  • Eine eigene Branchen- oder Themen-Tiefe, die dem Bereich ein Profil gibt.

  • Kein kanonischer Lebenslauf nötig: Director oder Partner-Anwärter aus einem großen Haus mit Mittelstands-Wellenlänge, Kanzlei-Führungskraft am Sprung zur eigenen Bereichsverantwortung, Inhaber, der seine Praxis einbringen und als Bereichs-Owner weiterbauen will. Wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett; die ausgewiesene Spanne bezieht sich auf das Primärprofil, und ein anderer Hintergrund startet zu einem anderen Marktpreis und konvergiert nach zwölf Monaten bewährter Leistung auf das Rollen-Niveau.

Was diese Rolle ist, und was nicht

  • Owner, kein Titel. Du trägst Strategie, Output und Ergebnis deines Bereichs, nicht ein Schild an der Tür.

  • Nah an der Linie, nicht aus der Distanz. Du bleibst an den wichtigsten Mandanten selbst nah dran. Reine Steuerung von oben gibt es hier nicht.

  • Wachstum, kein Erbhof. Dein Auftrag ist der Ausbau des Bereichs, nicht die Verwaltung des Bestands.

Warum Vogel

  • Ein Bereich, der wächst, ohne dass du ihn erfinden musst. Der Bestand trägt, und jede Übernahme bringt Mandate, die in deine Linie kommen.

  • Die Fleißarbeit nimmt dem Bereich das System ab. Wir automatisieren die deklaratorische Arbeit selbst, und unser eigener Jahresabschluss mit KI ist der Beleg. Deine Linie gewinnt damit Zeit für Beratung.

  • Du willst entscheiden: Zuschnitt, Standards und Wachstumslinie deines Bereichs. Vogel ist hierarchisch in der Entscheidung, flach in der Kommunikation, autonom in der Ausführung, ohne konkurrierende Eigeninteressen einer Partnergesellschaft.

  • Substanz im Rücken. Ein profitables, wachsendes Unternehmen mit etablierten Mandanten und langer Erfahrung.

FAQ

1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr?

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen.

2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen?

Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick.

3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet?

Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem.

4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung?

Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns.

5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung?

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values.

6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es?

Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren.

7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub?

Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt.

Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. Urlaub: 28 Tage.

GetMentioned.com ist die SEO-Plattform für Sichtbarkeit in Google und KI-Suchen. Dafür kombinieren wir unsere eigene Content Engine TextRocket mit einem Online-PR-Marktplatz mit über 100.000 Publishern.

Deine Mission

Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden schnell, sauber und profitabel die Offpage-Ergebnisse bekommen, für die sie uns bezahlen: präzise Buchungen, stabile Publisher-Beziehungen und messbare SEO-Effekte.

Wichtiger Hinweis zur Rolle

Mindestens 70–80 % deiner Zeit sind konzentrierte Abarbeitung:

  • volle Inbox runterarbeiten (Kunden- & Publisher-Mails)

  • Buchungen korrekt durchziehen

  • Pläne bauen, nachhalten, kontrollieren

Wenn du Freude an strukturierter, teils monotoner Arbeit mit hohem Durchsatz hast, wirst du diese Rolle lieben. Wenn du nur brainstormen willst ist das hier nichts für dich.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Buchungen und Kampagnenaufträge unserer Kunden im System aufnehmen, prüfen und sauber abwickeln

  • Passende Publisher für Kundenprojekte auswählen, anfragen und Konditionen innerhalb der Vorgaben klären

  • Full‑Service‑Offpage‑Pläne für Kunden ausarbeiten (Linkpakete, Platzierungspläne, Timings)

  • Laufende Kommunikation mit Kunden und Publishern (E‑Mail, Plattform, Calls)

  • Lektorat von SEO Texten auf Deutsch & Englisch

  • Qualität der Placements sichern: Themen‑Fit, KPIs, Verlinkung, Prüfung, Reporting

  • Bestehende Publisher-Beziehungen pflegen und neue relevante Quellen identifizieren

  • Datenpflege & Auswertungen in unseren Tools (z. B. Eigene Plattform, CRM, SEO‑Tools)

  • Prozesse mitdenken: Engpässe erkennen, Verbesserungsvorschläge machen und mit uns umsetzen

Was du mitbringst

  • 1–2+ Jahre Erfahrung in Offpage‑SEO / Linkbuilding / Digital PR oder Publisher‑Management

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort UND Schrift

  • Gutes Englisch; Französisch ist ein Plus

  • Erfahrung mit mind. einem SEO‑Tool (z. B. Ahrefs, Sistrix, Semrush o. Ä.)

  • Du hast kein Problem damit, täglich viele Vorgänge diszipliniert abzuarbeiten

  • Du nutzt KI jeden Tag. Mit ChatGPT, Claude oder ähnlichen Werkzeugen machst du Mails, Texte und Auswertungen schneller, und du prüfst, was sie liefern.

  • Du meldest Probleme, bevor jemand fragt, und wartest nicht auf Anweisungen.

  • Du willst Feedback. Sagt dir jemand, was nicht funktioniert hat, machst du es beim nächsten Mal besser.

  • Du bezeichnest dich selbst als zuverlässig, schnell, hungrig, entwicklungsbereit

Was wir dir bieten

  • Klare Verantwortlichkeit für einen Kernbereich unseres Geschäfts (Fulfillment, Offpage & Publisher)

  • Klare Ziele statt Micromanagement: du bekommst KPIs und den Rahmen, den Rest regelst du

  • Entwicklungsoptionen Richtung Lead Offpage SEO / Teamlead Publisher Management

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit fester Erreichbarkeit, Remote‑Option, 40h/Woche

  • Faires, transparentes Gehaltspaket mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeit (Range: 35.000 € - 45.000 € brutto jährlich, je nach Erfahrung)

Unsere Werte

Nach diesen vier Werten stellen wir ein, geben Feedback und entscheiden, wer mehr Verantwortung bekommt.

  • Ergebnisse zählen. Jede Aufgabe hat ein Ergebnis und einen Termin. Deine Zahlen kennst du, bevor jemand fragt.

  • Schnell entscheiden. Fragen sind am selben Tag geklärt. Eine gute Entscheidung heute ist uns lieber als eine perfekte nächste Woche.

  • Direktes Feedback. Wir sagen sofort, was gut war und was nicht, in beide Richtungen. Feedback setzt du beim nächsten Versuch um.

  • Verantwortung vom ersten Tag. Wer ein Problem sieht, kümmert sich darum. Was zweimal von Hand passiert, baust du beim dritten Mal als festen Ablauf oder gemeinsam mit unserer DEV-Abteilung als Prozess.

So bewirbst du dich

Nutzen Sie den Bewerben-Button auf dieser Seite, um uns Ihre Unterlagen zu senden.

Danach geht es so weiter:

  • Runde 1: Gespräch per Video, 15 Minuten. Wir stellen Rolle, Ziele und Werte vor und stellen/beantworten alle Fragen.

  • Runde 2: Arbeitsprobe. Du bekommst ein echtes Kundenprojekt und eine Liste von Domains. Du wählst die passenden Publisher aus, begründest die Auswahl und baust daraus einen kleinen Plan. Ebenfalls stellen wir Dir 2 weitere Test-Aufgaben zur Verfügung.

  • Runde 3: Live-Übung per Video, 30 Minuten. Wir spielen einen Publisher, der eine Frist gerissen hat, und einen verärgerten Kunden. Danach sagen wir dir direkt, was nicht funktioniert hat, und du machst es noch einmal.

Jobbeschreibung

StackFuel ist seit Jahren einer der führenden Anbieter für Daten- und KI-Weiterbildung in Deutschland. Seit Anfang 2026 sind wir Teil von Multiverse, Europas einzigem EdTech-Unicorn und der größten AI-Upskilling-Plattform des Kontinents. Gemeinsam verfolgen wir ein klares Ziel: 100.000 Beschäftigte in Deutschland fit für KI zu machen und so die Daten- und KI-Kompetenzlücke im Land zu schließen.

Gerade jetzt stehen wir an einem spannenden Punkt: Als Scale-up migrieren und konsolidieren wir unsere Infrastruktur von einzelnen Systemen auf einen skalierbaren Cloud-Stack, bei laufendem Betrieb, ohne Abstriche bei Uptime und Performance. Dafür suchen wir einen Tech Lead AI DevOps / Infrastructure (w/m/d), der unsere Infrastruktur ganzheitlich verantwortet: Du baust sie auf, skalierst sie und schaffst damit die Grundlage, auf der unser Team wachsen kann. Das machst du mit einem kleinen DevOps-Team, das du führst. Langfristig sorgst du mit deinem Team dafür, dass unsere Engineering-Teams im Rahmen eines Agentic SDLC ihre Produkte effizient auf sicherer und skalierbarer Infrastruktur shippen können.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du arbeitest als DevOps Tech Lead, das heißt du bist aktiver Contributor (Player & Coach) mit Führungsverantwortung für ein kleines Team und berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Engineering

  • Du verantwortest die Skalierung, Wartung und Sicherung unserer gesamten Cloud-Infrastruktur, von der laufenden Migration bis zum stabilen Tagesbetrieb, und legst damit das Fundament, auf dem Team und Produkt wachsen können

  • Du baust saubere Prozesse für Monitoring, Uptime, Backups und Recovery, Access Management, Security-Updates und Kostenkontrolle auf, wo heute noch vieles gewachsen und unstrukturiert ist

  • Du setzt AI gezielt im DevOps-Alltag ein, von Incident-Analyse über Infrastruktur-Code bis hin zu Runbooks, und automatisierst wiederkehrende Betriebsaufgaben konsequent, damit ein kleines Team maximale Wirkung erzielt

  • Du stellst sicher, dass interne und externe Entwicklung zuverlässig von DevOps unterstützt wird

  • Du bereitest die Weiterentwicklung des Teams hin zu Platform Engineering für unseren Standort Berlin vor.

Was du mitbringst

  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in DevOps, SRE oder Platform Engineering, davon erste Lead-Verantwortung (Architektur, technische Entscheidungen, Mentoring)

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit AI-gestütztem DevOps, also dem Einsatz von AI zur Automatisierung und Sicherung von Betrieb und Infrastruktur

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Infrastructure as Code und Container-Orchestrierung, z. B. mit Terraform, Kubernetes und Ansible

Passt eher nicht zu dir, wenn …

Diese Rolle ist wahrscheinlich nicht das Richtige für dich, wenn du lieber führst, als selbst Hand anzulegen. Mit einem kleinen Team bist du Tech Lead und Engineer zugleich und bleibst selbst tief im System, im Design und im Code. Sie passt auch nicht gut, wenn du eine aufgeräumte Umgebung mit fertigen Prozessen erwartest: Vieles bei uns ist gewachsen, und genau dort Struktur zu schaffen, ist ein Kern deiner Aufgabe. Und wenn du AI-Tools eher als nettes Produktivitäts-Extra siehst und nicht als etwas, das die Arbeitsweise eines ganzen Teams grundlegend verändert, wirst du hier eher nicht glücklich.

Arbeitskultur

Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Workation

Raum für Austausch

Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung

Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

You’ll do this with a small DevOps team that you lead. In the long term, you and your team will ensure that our engineering teams can efficiently ship their products on secure, scalable infrastructure as part of an agentic SDLC.

Your Responsibilities

  • Work as DevOps Tech Lead, meaning you’re an active contributor (player & coach) with leadership responsibility for a small team, reporting directly to our Head of Engineering

  • Own the scaling, maintenance, and security of our entire cloud infrastructure, from the ongoing migration to stable day-to-day operations, laying the foundation for team and product growth

  • Establish clean processes for monitoring, uptime, backups and recovery, access management, security updates, and cost control, in areas that have grown organically and are still largely unstructured today

  • Use AI deliberately in day-to-day DevOps work, from incident analysis to infrastructure code to runbooks, and consistently automate recurring operational tasks so a small team can achieve maximum impact

  • Ensure that internal and external development is reliably supported by DevOps

  • Prepare the team’s evolution toward platform engineering for our Berlin location

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including initial lead responsibility (architecture, technical decisions, mentoring)

  • Solid knowledge of infrastructure as code and container orchestration, e.g. with Terraform, Kubernetes, and Ansible

  • Experience operating an enterprise stack with many components (data warehouses, applications, databases, logging, security audits, permission systems) and a strong sense for security, backups, and recovery

data.description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades – together, with modern software and smart AI solutions.
We don’t just develop software – we’re on a mission to give tradespeople and contractors more room to focus on what matters. We do this by providing a practical SaaS solution that works the way they do: fast, efficient, and without unnecessary administrative overhead. Supported by smart AI features exactly where they make a real difference in everyday work.
Backed by Tier 1 investors from Europe and the US such as Headline and Creandum, and with more than 30,000 craftspeople as our customer base, we are scaling across Europe to turn individual, scattered businesses into connected and successful communities.
We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people wearing safety boots in mind, not suits. We’re excited to shape the future together as a team, staying grounded in our mission to empower the builders and makers of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As a Working Student / Intern GTM AI Growth Engineering, you build and launch AI-powered growth experiments that create new qualified demand for plancraft across Europe. From interactive calculators and landing pages to AI-powered tools, you turn ideas into live experiments, measure their impact on revenue, and scale what works. You help build an automated, intelligence-driven go-to-market engine that grows without adding manual work.

Your Responsibilities

  • Build and launch AI-powered acquisition experiments using tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor – from interactive calculators and landing pages to simple AI widgets.

  • Own the experiment pipeline – collect ideas, prioritize them by expected revenue impact and effort, and continuously prepare the next tests.

  • Measure what works – define clear hypotheses, set up tracking with GA4, Mixpanel, and HubSpot, and evaluate experiments based on qualified leads, pipeline, and conversion.

  • Automate lead generation – connect experiments to HubSpot, ensuring leads are captured, qualified, and routed with clean data and minimal manual effort.

  • Scale successful experiments internationally – adapt winning tools and campaigns for international markets like Italy, Spain, and the Netherlands.

  • Document learnings and share results – write concise experiment briefs, report outcomes transparently, and present your latest experiments in our weekly RevOps meeting.

  • Turn experiments into scalable solutions – hand over successful initiatives to the responsible teams and shut down unsuccessful tests efficiently.

  • Collaborate across Marketing, Sales, and RevOps to ensure experiments follow our brand, tracking, and data standards while generating actionable insights for future growth.

YOUR PROFILE

Must-haves:

  • You’re currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program (at least two semesters completed), ideally in Industrial Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related technical or business-technical field.

  • You've already built and launched something independently – whether an app, website, automation, or side project. It doesn't need to be perfect, but it needs to work.

  • You're comfortable using at least one AI building tool such as Lovable, Claude, or Cursor and can understand basic HTML, JavaScript, and API documentation.

  • You understand the fundamentals of digital acquisition funnels and can connect an experiment hypothesis to a measurable outcome.

  • You take ownership from idea to execution, learn new tools independently, and prioritize shipping and learning over unnecessary perfection.

  • You communicate clearly, document your work concisely, and are comfortable sharing results openly – including experiments that didn't succeed.

  • You have fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

  • You're available for 16–20 hours per week during the semester and remain enrolled at university throughout your working student contract. For an internship, you can commit to at least four months, ideally six months.

  • You are based in Hamburg or willing to relocate to Hamburg for the duration of your internship or working student position.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Initial experience with GA4, Mixpanel, landing page optimization, SEO, copywriting, or conversion tracking.

  • Experience with automation tools like n8n or working with APIs.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, Webflow, Figma, Linear, GitHub, Asana, or Claude Code.

  • Experience launching a project with real users – whether through a startup, university initiative, personal project, or public launch.

  • Interest in tradespeople, small businesses, and understanding how digital tools can improve their daily work.

  • German skills at C1 level or additional language skills in Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or Polish.

 


WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

 

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Note on creating a test account:
If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.

About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni)

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

Role summary

How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?

We're looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You'll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling.   • Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact.
  • Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.

  • Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You'll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff.

  • Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master's degree program.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations.
  • Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output.
  • An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results.

This role is for you if you thrive on responsibility, learn quickly, and are naturally proactive.

Mission
Integral was founded in October 2024 by Lukas Zörner and Anil Can Baykal and is one of the fastest-growing startups in Germany. We're building the leading AI-native platform for accounting, payroll and tax for European SMEs, starting with Germany. We're backed by General Catalyst, Cherry Ventures, Puzzle Ventures and entrepreneurs from across Europe.

We're currently just over 50 people and hiring in two very different markets. On one side, tax advisors, certified accountants and payroll accountants, who are in demand nationwide and have to be won over from secure, permanent roles. On the other, AI engineers, product builders and GTM profiles, where the strongest companies in Berlin are competing for the same people.

As Talent Acquisition Manager, you own these roles and take them from start to finish, from the intake with the team to the signed offer. You're the first hire in the Talent team, so very little is set in stone yet and a lot is yours to decide.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own your vacancies across the full cycle: intake, sourcing, screening, interview loop, debrief, offer and close.

  • Source actively. It's a big part of the role. You identify the profiles we're looking for, reach out directly and convince them to make a move they hadn't been thinking about. Research, longlists and outreach are yours.

  • Own the inbound side. You handle incoming applications, from review through first calls to the final response. Most of the volume arrives in the first few days after a role goes live and whoever responds fastest has the best conversations first.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers. Sharpen the role profile together before the first review, agree on evaluation criteria up front and run the debriefs. Where an interview loop could work better, you propose changes and put them in place.

  • Decide how we measure recruiting. You help decide which numbers we need, collect them and report on them regularly. When a search isn't working, you flag it early and can explain why.

  • Own our Ashby setup for your roles, from pipeline hygiene through templates and interview guides to reporting.

  • Keep the process at the pace we promise. Our job ads say under two weeks and candidates rely on it.

What we're not looking for

  • People who wait for a briefing before they start.

  • Anyone who sees recruiting mainly as forwarding CVs.

  • Anyone who won't push back on a hiring manager when the role profile doesn't fit the market.

Your Profile
You don't need to bring all of this. The first three points matter most.

  • You've recruited in-house across the full cycle and closed candidates yourself. If you started at an agency and then moved in-house, that works just as well.

  • You're business-fluent in German (C1+) and have good English (B2+). Some of our candidates speak German only.

  • You source yourself and can show us in conversation how you approach a difficult search: search logic, outreach and what comes back.

  • You look at your funnel numbers and know where your biggest lever is.

  • You work fluently with AI tools and use them to automate the repetitive parts of your work.

  • You write well. A first message that gets a reply even from someone who isn't looking and rejections that make candidates want to come back to us later.

What sets you apart

  • You've recruited across very different functions and switch between them quickly. In the same week, we might run a search in payroll, one in AI engineering and one in sales and all three need a different approach.

  • You've introduced structured hiring at a company that didn't have it before.

  • You've set up and maintained an ATS like Ashby or Greenhouse yourself.

  • You have experience at a fast-growing company between Seed and Series B.

The Hiring Process
We move fast. For the right person, the full process takes less than two weeks.

  1. Virtual intro call with us

  2. Virtual call with the hiring manager

  3. Short take-home case study

  4. Final in person meeting to meet our team and explore the office

  5. Offer

Our Offer

  • Above-market salary

  • First hire in the Talent team, with real influence on how we hire from here on

  • Direct line to the Founders: no filter, no queue, no committee

  • The best AI tools: Claude Max, Cursor, OpenAI, whatever ships next week

  • 28 vacation days per year, plus half-days on December 24 and 31

  • Urban Sports Club membership, Sachbezug with over 200 partner companies, or Deutschlandticket, your choice

  • Modern equipment, including a MacBook

  • Company pension scheme (bAV)

  • Modern office in the heart of Berlin Prenzlauer Berg, right next to Mauerpark

  • Weekly team lunches, office BBQs and a dinner budget for late nights after 8 pm

  • A team of 50+ (and growing) ambitious, diverse people, 20%+ ex-founders learning and building together

Even if you don't tick every box, but the role and the environment excite you: apply. We value diversity and hire people based on their ability to do the job. People of every background, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status, political belief, or marital status are welcome at Integral.

About the Company

Infinite Orbits GmbH is the German subsidiary of Infinite Orbits SAS, a NewSpace company founded in 2017 that now has more than 200 employees, with locations including Luxembourg, the UK, Spain, and Singapore.

The company develops in-orbit servicing solutions built on its own autonomous Rendezvous and Proximity Operations (RPO) technology, spanning awareness, surveillance, inspection, and protection of space assets through to life extension.

With its newly established Munich site, Infinite Orbits builds a dedicated local presence in Germany, developing capabilities in business development, R&D, product development, system engineering, production, and mission operations to enable Europe's defense and space sector.

Infinite Orbits is looking for the founding team for its Munich site. Candidates who bring entrepreneurial drive, thrive in ambiguity, want ownership over what they build, and want to make a real difference in space are invited to explore the open positions on the company's website.

Job Description

About the Role

As Satellite Systems Engineer, you own the spacecraft. You turn the agreed mission concept into a buildable, verifiable spacecraft solution covering platform, payload, and their interfaces, drawing on the Infinite Orbits Group's platforms and on German suppliers and partners.

Proposal preparation is a core part of this role: you author the spacecraft design sections of Infinite Orbits Germany's bids, RFI/RFP responses, and funding applications. You substantiate sizing, heritage, and maturity, consolidate supplier input, and make sure that what we offer can be built, verified, and delivered within the cost and schedule we commit to. You work hand in hand with the Mission Systems Engineer, who owns the mission concept, and the Proposal & Project Manager, who runs the proposal process.

Once contracts are won, you carry the spacecraft design through reviews, verification, and integration, and you help build up spacecraft engineering and integration capability in Munich as our German hardware content grows.

  • Spacecraft proposal content: Author the spacecraft design sections of RFI/RFP responses, customer proposals, and national and European funding applications, covering configuration, subsystem and payload selection, spacecraft budgets, heritage and maturity (TRL) justification, compliance, and technical risks.

  • Cost & schedule input for bids: Provide the Proposal & Project Manager with the technical basis for proposal cost and schedule, including make-or-buy decisions, supplier selection, procurement lead times, and verification and integration effort.

  • Supplier & partner input: Request, assess, and consolidate technical offers from suppliers and partners into a coherent proposal baseline.

  • Spacecraft requirements & budgets: Own spacecraft-level requirements derived from the mission baseline and manage spacecraft budgets (mass, power, thermal, link, pointing, propellant) through design and delivery.

  • Interfaces & integration: Define and manage platform, payload, and subsystem interfaces (ICDs), including the integration of payloads and subsystems from German partners.

  • Design reviews & verification: Prepare spacecraft design reviews and own verification and test planning at spacecraft level.

  • Project execution: Own spacecraft engineering workstreams on won contracts, ensuring delivery against technical and contractual requirements.

  • Group coordination: Work closely with platform engineering in Toulouse and other Group entities to reuse existing designs and keep the spacecraft baseline consistent across the Group.

  • Capability build-up: Support the build-up of spacecraft integration and verification capability in Germany as the German hardware share grows.

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Engineering degree in aerospace, space systems engineering, or a related field, or equivalent.

  • 3+ years of experience in spacecraft systems engineering, ideally at platform, prime, or integrator level.

  • Experience contributing spacecraft design, cost, or schedule content to technical proposals in the space or defense sector.

  • Experience with spacecraft integration, verification, or AIT is a plus.

Skills & Other Requirements

  • Strong command of spacecraft subsystems and their interactions (AOCS/GNC, power, thermal, propulsion, communications, structures, data handling).

  • Working knowledge of ECSS standards and spacecraft verification approaches.

  • Ability to size and defend spacecraft solutions, including heritage and maturity claims, under customer or stakeholder scrutiny.

  • Excellent structured writing: able to turn design work into clear, compliant proposal content under deadline pressure.

  • Experience working with suppliers and partners on technical offers and interface definitions.

  • Autonomy and ownership: comfortable owning workstreams independently in an early-stage, cross-border team environment, working closely with Group entities in France and beyond.

  • Fluent in German and English.

  • Willingness to undergo a German security clearance procedure (Sicherheitsüberprüfung).

  • Frequent travel required within Germany and to Infinite Orbits' HQ in Toulouse and other European locations.

What we offer

  • A founding technical role with direct ownership of spacecraft design and proposal content in a growing European space and defense company.

  • Direct influence on how Infinite Orbits builds spacecraft engineering and integration capability in Germany, in close collaboration with the Infinite Orbits Group.

We are looking forward to your application!

Mit dem neuen Standort in München baut Infinite Orbits eine eigene Präsenz in Deutschland auf und entwickelt Kompetenzen in den Bereichen Business Development, Forschung und Entwicklung, Produktentwicklung, Systems Engineering, Produktion und Missionsbetrieb, um den europäischen Verteidigungs- und Raumfahrtsektor zu stärken.

Infinite Orbits sucht das Gründungsteam für den Standort München. Gesucht werden Menschen mit unternehmerischem Antrieb, die sich in offenen, wenig strukturierten Situationen wohlfühlen, Verantwortung für das übernehmen möchten, was sie aufbauen, und die Raumfahrt aktiv mitgestalten wollen.

Über die Rolle

Als Business Development Manager bauen Sie den Kundenstamm von Infinite Orbits Germany im deutschen und europäischen Verteidigungs- und institutionellen Raumfahrtsektor auf und aus. Sie entwickeln Beziehungen zur Bundeswehr und ihren Beschaffungsorganisationen, zur Deutschen Raumfahrtagentur im DLR, zur ESA, zu europäischen Institutionen sowie zu Hauptauftragnehmern und Partnern aus der Industrie und führen Opportunities vom ersten Kontakt bis zum unterzeichneten Vertrag.

Die Angebotserstellung ist zentral für Ihren Erfolg: Sie verantworten Capture-Strategie, Win-Strategie, Preisgestaltung und Vertragsbedingungen jedes Angebots, in enger Abstimmung mit dem Proposal & Project Manager, der den Angebotsprozess steuert, und dem Mission Systems Engineer bis zur Abgabe und Verhandlung.

Als Teil des Gründungsteams prägen Sie vom ersten Tag an, wie sich Infinite Orbits Germany gegenüber Kunden und Partnern positioniert.

Aufgaben

  • Pipeline-Verantwortung: Identifikation, Qualifizierung und Nachverfolgung von Opportunities bei Verteidigungs-, institutionellen und kommerziellen Kunden; Verantwortung für die deutsche Vertriebspipeline, den Forecast und das CRM.

  • Kunden- und Stakeholderbeziehungen: Aufbau und Pflege vertrauensvoller Beziehungen zu Entscheidungs- und Bedarfsträgern bei der Bundeswehr, ihren Beschaffungsorganisationen, der Deutschen Raumfahrtagentur im DLR, der ESA, europäischen Institutionen und Hauptauftragnehmern der Industrie.

  • Capture Management: Gestaltung von Opportunities lange vor formalen Ausschreibungen: Kundenbedarf und Budgets verstehen, Anforderungen über RFI-Antworten und frühzeitigen Austausch mitgestalten und Bid/No-Bid-Entscheidungen vorbereiten.

  • Angebotsführung: Verantwortung für Win-Strategie, Preisgestaltung, kaufmännische und vertragliche Bedingungen sowie Teaming-Vereinbarungen; Mitwirkung an den vom Proposal & Project Manager geleiteten Angebotsreviews; Führung von Klärungsrunden und Vertragsverhandlungen.

  • Partnerschaften & Teaming: Aufbau von Partnerschaften und Konsortien mit der deutschen Industrie, KMU und Forschungseinrichtungen für gemeinsame Angebote und Programme.

  • Beschaffungs- und Förderprogramme: Beobachtung nationaler und europäischer Beschaffungs- und Förderinstrumente in Raumfahrt und Verteidigung und Qualifizierung von Opportunities, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den R&D and Innovation Managern.

  • Marktbeobachtung: Analyse von Kundenprogrammen, Budgets, Wettbewerbern und Partnerlandschaft; Einbringen der Erkenntnisse in die Produktpositionierung und das Angebot der Gruppe.

  • Repräsentation: Vertretung von Infinite Orbits auf Messen, Konferenzen, Kundentagen und in Industrieverbänden.

  • Gruppenkoordination: Abstimmung mit Business Development und Vertrieb der Infinite-Orbits-Gruppe zu Account-Strategie, Angeboten und Preisgestaltung für einen einheitlichen Kundenauftritt.

Anforderungen

Ausbildung & Erfahrung

  • Studium der Ingenieurwissenschaften, der Betriebswirtschaft oder eines verwandten Fachs oder gleichwertige Erfahrung.

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Raumfahrt- und Verteidigungsindustrie in einer leitenden Funktion, z. B. im Projekt- oder Programmmanagement, in der technischen Leitung oder in der kaufmännischen Leitung.

  • Erfahrung in kundennaher Tätigkeit, mit Angeboten oder mit öffentlichen Programmen ist von Vorteil.

  • Ein etabliertes Netzwerk im deutschen Verteidigungs- und Raumfahrtumfeld (Bundeswehr, Beschaffungsorganisationen, DLR, Industrie) ist ein großer Vorteil.

Fähigkeiten & weitere Anforderungen

  • Fundiertes Verständnis deutscher und europäischer Vergabeverfahren in Raumfahrt und Verteidigung.

  • Ausreichendes technisches Verständnis von Raumfahrtsystemen, um In-Orbit-Servicing- und RPO-Lösungen mit Kunden glaubwürdig zu diskutieren.

  • Kaufmännisches Gespür und Verhandlungssicherheit gegenüber Kunden und Partnern.

  • Ausgeprägte Schreib- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten: Sie erstellen überzeugende, ausschreibungskonforme kaufmännische Angebotsinhalte auch unter Termindruck.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungswille: Sie bauen gern eine Funktion von null an auf, in einem grenzüberschreitenden Team im Aufbau und in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Gesellschaften der Gruppe in Frankreich und darüber hinaus.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

  • Bereitschaft, sich einer Sicherheitsüberprüfung (SÜG) zu unterziehen.

  • Regelmäßige Reisetätigkeit innerhalb Deutschlands sowie zum Hauptsitz von Infinite Orbits in Toulouse und zu weiteren europäischen Standorten.

Was wir bieten

  • Eine Rolle im Gründungsteam mit direkter Verantwortung für Kundenbeziehungen, Capture und Angebote in einem wachsenden europäischen Raumfahrt- und Verteidigungsunternehmen.

  • Direkter Austausch mit hochrangigen Vertreterinnen und Vertretern aus Politik, Verteidigung und Industrie sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung und der Infinite-Orbits-Gruppe.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Infinite Orbits GmbH is the German subsidiary of Infinite Orbits SAS, a NewSpace company founded in 2017 that now has more than 200 employees, with locations including Luxembourg, the UK, Spain, and Singapore.

The company develops in-orbit servicing solutions built on its own autonomous Rendezvous and Proximity Operations (RPO) technology, spanning awareness, surveillance, inspection, and protection of space assets through to life extension.

With its newly established Munich site, Infinite Orbits builds a dedicated local presence in Germany, developing capabilities in business development, R&D, product development, system engineering, production, and mission operations to enable Europe's defense and space sector.

Tasks

As R&D and Innovation Manager, you own Infinite Orbits Germany's research and innovation agenda in sensing and autonomy technologies, spanning RF, optical, and robotics hardware as well as the data postprocessing and object detection software that turns their output into mission value. We are hiring two R&D and Innovation Managers with complementary profiles: one with a focus on robotics and GNC, and one with a focus on sensing (RF and optical) and data processing.

Beyond driving R&D in Germany, you help push product development for the wider Infinite Orbits Group, feeding German engineering excellence and technology access directly into the Group's product roadmap. You identify technology opportunities relevant to the German and European market, build the company's university and research-institution network, and secure non-dilutive funding to support technology maturation. You are a primary driver of Infinite Orbits' presence in the German innovation ecosystem, working closely with the engineering team to align research priorities with the company's technical roadmap and with Group entities to leverage existing technology developments.

R&D agenda ownership: Define and drive the German R&D roadmap across sensing and autonomy technologies (RF, optical, robotics, data postprocessing, and object detection), identifying gaps and opportunities that strengthen Infinite Orbits' competitive and technical positioning.

  • Group product development contribution: Feed German technology developments, research partnerships, and engineering excellence into the wider Infinite Orbits Group's product roadmap, ensuring German innovation strengthens the Group's overall offering.
  • University & research partnerships: Own and grow relationships with German universities and research institutions active in these fields; identify and structure collaboration, thesis, and joint-research opportunities.
  • Funding program ownership: Identify, pursue, and own applications to national and European funding programs for technology development, from scoping through submission and reporting, with the Proposal & Project Manager running the proposal process.
  • Technology scouting: Track emerging RF, optical, robotics, data postprocessing, and object detection technologies and potential partners or suppliers relevant to RPO and in-orbit servicing, assessing fit with Infinite Orbits' roadmap.
  • Group coordination: Work with Engineering in Toulouse and other Group entities to align German R&D activities in these areas with the broader Group technology roadmap and avoid duplication of effort.
  • Stakeholder engagement: Represent Infinite Orbits at innovation-focused events, university engagements, and research consortia relevant to sensing and autonomy technology in the German space and defense sector.

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Engineering or scientific degree, or equivalent, in a field relevant to RF systems, optical systems, robotics, GNC, or software/data processing; PhD or strong research background a plus.
  • 3+ years of experience in R&D management, innovation management, or research collaboration in sensing or autonomy technology, ideally in the space, defense, or deep-tech sector.
  • Track record of securing and managing publicly funded R&D projects (national or EU level) is a strong plus.

Skills & Other Requirements

  • Working technical understanding of sensing and autonomy technologies as applied to space or in-orbit servicing missions (RF systems, optical sensing/communication, robotics, data postprocessing, and object detection). Deep expertise in one or two of these areas is expected; working literacy in the others is sufficient.
  • Strong network-building ability with universities, research institutions, and innovation ecosystems across these technology domains.
  • Solid understanding of funding program structures and application processes.
  • Comfortable owning a new function independently in an early-stage, cross-border team environment.
  • Fluent in German and English.
  • Willingness to undergo a German security clearance procedure (Sicherheitsüberprüfung).
  • Frequent travel required within Germany and to Infinite Orbits' HQ in Toulouse and other European locations.

Benefits

  • A founding role shaping Infinite Orbits Germany's R&D and innovation strategy in sensing and autonomy technologies from the ground up, with direct influence on the wider Group's product roadmap.
  • Direct exposure to Germany's university, research, and innovation-funding ecosystem in the space and defense sector.

We are looking forward to your application!

About Atira

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.

We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!

Why engineers are the foundation of everything Atira ships

As an Engineering Intern at Atira, you will work on frontier AI technology, such as (recursive) agent harnesses, runtimes, evals, inference and self-verification in complex engineering domains. You build the frameworks, primitives and scaffolding that let agents reliably handle complex industrial processes end to end, from the first inbound RFQ to the write-back into ERP.

Misreading or wrongly interpreting a spec can cost a manufacturer six figures, so the challenges are real and the margin for error is thin.

Where you trained matters less than what you've built and how clearly you can describe what broke. Atira is at a stage where you must own problems end to end, because what you ship today is what our customers use tomorrow.

What you will do

  • Work on the agent runtime and harnesses. You improve the core components that let Atira's agents reason in complex engineering environments across the entire sales-engineering lifecycle, orchestrate themselves recursively at scale through dynamic programs, and handle arbitrarily large amounts of data. This includes the runtime/sandboxing, the harness, and the outer orchestration layer that ties it together

  • Build out our AI moat. You are in charge of improving quality & evals, improving the ontology layer that unlocks compounding process knowledge and fusing deterministic guardrails with agentic agency to make our agents actionable at enterprise level complexity

  • Unlock industrial scale. Industrials live in multi-modal, data-heavy environments: 1000-page inbounds, pricing lists, CAD files, ERP tables, legacy applications. You scale the AI systems behind them to millions of concurrent LLM requests in isolated sandboxes, with no silent failures, cost blowouts or latency explosions.

  • Advance our internal tooling. FDEs, platform engineers and the GTM team depend on tooling you build to improve Atira's internal context layer, ambient agents, insight and observability engines

  • Work with FDEs when customer problems hit the platform. When an FDE hits a problem they should be able to pull you in. At a team of 20, the boundary between AI, platform and customer is thin, and you'll cross it regularly

What we are looking for

Ownership, depth, and the instinct to take problems personally, go deep until you understand the system, and own the outcome including the parts that broke.

Your profile

  • Agent fluency sits on top of real engineering fundamentals. Solid skills in Python, TypeScript, or a comparable language. We value someone that can still code without AI. Ideally paired with hands-on experience with agents, evals, harnesses, runtimes, sandboxing and tools

  • You've gone further than most with AI-assisted development. Whether it's Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or your own setup, you've invested seriously in building the skills, context, and workflows to get maximum leverage from coding agents. This isn't a nice-to-have. We think engineers who have mastered this are fundamentally more productive, and we hire accordingly

  • You reason clearly about technical tradeoffs. You don’t need to have run systems at scale yet, but you can think through how a design would hold up at thousands of requests per second and explain the pros and cons of different approaches. Every design has tradeoffs: no free lunch

  • You’ve demonstrated ownership and initiative. A side project you took further than anyone asked, a serious open-source contribution, a research project or a startup. We want evidence that you build without being told to and can explain what broke and why

  • You have a strong technical foundation. Enrolled or recently graduated in Computer Science, Information Systems, AI, or a related technical field from a strong technical university (cracked dropouts can qualify too though)

  • Full working proficiency in English. German is not required

  • You're ready for a real internship, not a side gig. You can commit to at least three months full-time, on-site in Munich

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: you'll be one of the early team members and shape both product and architecture as well as work closely with customers

  • Strong peers and mentorship: work with and learn from engineers who have shipped AI systems in industrial environments at scale, with the opportunity for mentorship along the way

  • Impactful work: your code is deployed all across Europe’s and US industrial backbone, affecting how complex products and services are sold and configured worldwide

  • Competitive salary and additional benefits

  • Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity

What success looks like at the end of the internship

  • You've shipped meaningful improvements to the agent runtime, our AI pipelines and related systems that are running in production across multiple customer deployments

  • You own one well-defined piece of our AI stack end to end (an eval suite, an internal tool, part of the context layer or the SDK), and the team trusts your judgment on how it should evolve

  • When something breaks in the part you own, you can trace it end to end, from agent behaviour back to the agent infrastructure layer, and fix it

  • You’ve made an improvement to our internal AI tooling that the team now uses day to day

data.description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You’ll join our Talent team and help build the team that builds a bank. We’re scaling fast across Berlin, New York and Dallas, and every hire either raises or lowers the bar. You’ll own real parts of our hiring engine from day one. Like everyone at Augustus, you’ll run day-to-day work in parallel with one or two larger projects.

  • What you’ll work on:

    • Source and engage candidates across engineering, product, operations, compliance and sales.

    • Coordinate interview processes and keep hiring managers and candidates moving.

    • Build and automate our recruiting workflows with Ashby, n8n and AI, so we hire better without adding headcount.

    • Own a larger project, like a new sourcing channel, our employer brand, or hiring analytics.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You are low ego and ready to jump in where you are needed most.

  • You are relentless about finding great people. You’d rather send 50 personalized messages than post and pray.

  • You know every candidate interaction reflects on Augustus, and you treat it that way.

  • You build your personal AI stack that optimizes your productivity and you treat new AI tools as defaults, not curiosities.

  • You can build workflows in n8n/zapier/make.

  • You are comfortable talking to senior leaders, hiring managers, and candidates from day one.

  • You are genuinely excited about what we are building.

This is not for you if:

  • You only want to work on strategic projects.

  • You see recruiting as admin work.

  • You need to know exactly what you will be working on before you join.

  • You are looking for a 9-5 role.

Hard Requirements

  • You are currently pursuing or have obtained a Bachelor's or Master's degree from a stellar institution.

  • You have 1-2 previous internships or roles in high-growth startups, venture capital, or consulting and/or you have demonstrated initiative through side projects, student organizations, research, or entrepreneurial experiences.

  • You are available for 3-6 months.

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

Compensation: €2.5K per month

Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA

 

Executive summary: A senior international key account role for a professional who excels in relationship management, stakeholder engagement, and strategic account development. In this position, you will be responsible for retaining, deepening, and further strengthening the partnership with one of SITA’s ( https://www.sita.aero/about-us/ )  most strategic clients.

Highlights: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics | SITA

·      End-to-end responsibility for a strategic international key account

·      Strong focus on relationship management, retention, and deepening the partnership with C-level, IT directors, Enterprise architects, both on the IT organization of the client as well the Business organization.

·      International sales and stakeholder management role with high visibility in the customer environment

·      Significant impact on client satisfaction, continuity and commercial development, including revenue management

·      Strong focus on managed IT and Connectivity services (infrastructure) and differentiated value propositions, based on the portfolio of SITA

·      Key position within an international team and complex IT enterprise and Business environment

·      Operational / dotted leadership of a highly skilled IT team of 6 FTE at client site

 

Purpose of the role

For SITA, we are looking for a Senior Account Director who will take international responsibility for the strategic international key account. In this role, the emphasis is on retaining, deepening, and future-proofing an existing client relationship with significant commercial and operational value. The focus is not on aggressive revenue growth, but on stability, continuity and additional commercial opportunities within an established international account.

 

About the role, building future proof relationships

As Senior Account Director, you will be responsible for managing and further developing the strategic international key account within SITA. You will operate in an international environment where relationship development focusing on account retention, you understand the complexity of enterprise. IT, data and connectivity sales and know how to create structural value within an existing client relationship.

 

The ideal candidate is an experienced sales professional with proven knowledge of strategic international key account as an organization, for example from a previous role as a supplier or strategic partner. IT knowledge and experience with managed services are important, but deep client knowledge, insight into decision-making structures, and an understanding of international stakeholder dynamics are even more critical in this position. You can build sustainable relationships at multiple levels, create internal and external alignment in a smart and distinctive way.

 

About SITA

SITA has been a leading technology partner for the international travel and transport sector since 1949. In its early years, the SITA company built one of the first large-scale communications networks for aviation and today continues to play a global role in making travel and logistics processes smarter, safer, and more efficient. SITA has since expanded this expertise into maritime services and managed services for logistics organizations

 

SITA supports organizations with contact center solutions, connectivity, digital collaboration, security, and managed services. Within this context, strategic international key account for whom SITA delivers services worldwide that directly contribute to customer contact, collaboration, and operational continuity.

Client context

The strategic international key account one of the world’s leading container shipping and logistics companies, with approximately 18.000 employees globally, 340 + offices in 120 + countries, and connections to more than 550 ports worldwide. The organization is known for its strong focus on quality, digitalization, customer centricity, and operational excellence.

For this role, insight into the international dynamics of a complex logistics organization is essential. You understand how technology, service delivery, and stakeholder management come together in an environment where continuity, reliability, and client satisfaction have a direct impact on the business.

The partnership between SITA and the strategic international key account is built on a strong foundation. Your assignment will be to further deepen this relationship, strengthen SITA’s position, and carefully and strategically develop new opportunities within the account.

 

Portfolio and services at the key account

·       Contact centre and voice solutions

·       Global connectivity solutions

·       Managed services for communication and office environments

·       Management of digital workplaces and office environments

·       Security solutions

 

What will you do?

·       You will have end-to-end responsibility for the international account management strategic key account within SITA.

·       You will build and deepen sustainable relationships with stakeholders at operational, tactical, and strategic levels.

·       You will safeguard the existing revenue base and drive maximum client retention in an environment where managed services are largely viewed as a commodity.

·       You will identify commercial opportunities and translate them into distinctive, relevant, and viable propositions.

·       You will clearly operate as a farmer rather than a hunter account retention, and strategic growth is the main focus.

·       You will position SITA as a partner that adds value more intelligently, effectively, and innovatively than the market expects.

·       You will work effectively with internal teams, senior stakeholders, and specialists to serve the client optimally.

·       You will provide day-to-day direction to a highly skilled IT delivery team of 6 FTE at the client (virtual and extended account team).

 

Terms of employment

This position offers a fixed gross monthly salary between €9.000,- and €11.000,- gross monthly, complemented by an attractive variable compensation model. The bonus structure consists of a sales incentive based on revenue, with approximately 40% of the variable compensation linked to renewals. In addition, you will receive commission on closed deals. With strong performance, a total package of up to approximately €160,000 OTE is achievable.

Procedure

Following a successful introductory phone call, you will have 2 face-to-face meetings with a SoundPeople senior consultant. If both sides see sufficient reason to move forward, we will introduce you to SITA. You will then go through three interview rounds with the client:

 

The first interview round will take place with a Account Executive of SITA (Central Europe) and an HR professional. The second round will be with the SVP of Central Europe and the current Account Director. In the final stage, the ultimate selection and terms of employment will be aligned with the President of Europe and the COO.

 

Interested?

 

This opportunity is designed for an accomplished enterprise account leader who understands that a mature strategic relationship still requires energy, precision and continuous development. If you can combine executive stakeholder management with commercial ownership and coordinated delivery, we would like to hear from you.

 

Contact Sven Fremeijer at Sound People BV, Executive Search

LinkedIn:  https://www.linkedin.com/in/svenfremeijer/


Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a senior sales professional with extensive experience in complex enterprise environments and a strong understanding of international client dynamics. Ideally, you know the strategic international key account from a supplier or partner perspective and understand the organization, its decision-making processes, and the interests at play. You combine commercial sharpness with high-level know how to create momentum based on trust, substance, and personal leadership.

 

·      Proven experience in MSP, IT, managed services and/or Telco environments

·      Deep client knowledge and preferably previous experience with strategic key account

·      Creative, innovative, and strategically strong in commercial positioning

·      Excellent networker and a credible sparring partner at C-level

·      Structured, results-driven, and operationally strong

·      Able to move organizations forward through relationships and trust, rather than hierarchy or pressure

·      Must: Excellent communication skills in an international environment.

About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The opportunity

As the Engineering Manager for the Infrastructure domain, you will lead the teams responsible for the foundations that power Distribusion's products and operations. Covering Platform Engineering, IT, and Information Security, your mission is to build scalable, secure, and reliable systems that enable our engineering teams and the wider business to operate at their best.

To prepare our technical foundation for 10x growth, we are looking for a highly strategic, business-oriented leader to transform how these critical functions operate. You will act as the crucial bridge between our infrastructure and the broader company by professionalising our tech stack, driving complex vendor negotiations, and building transparent roadmaps that clearly showcase your team's impact.

What you will do

  • You'll lead the teams that keep Distribusion running securely, reliably, and at scale.

  • From cloud infrastructure and developer tooling to internal IT and information security, you'll be responsible for the platforms and processes that enable our teams to move fast with confidence.

  • You'll grow and support a team spanning Platform Engineering, IT, and Security, helping define strategy, drive execution, and raise the bar for operational excellence across the company.

  • Vendor management including negotiating conditions and overseeing detailed infrastructure and project cost tracking.

  • Your work will directly impact the productivity of our engineers, the resilience of our systems, and the security of our business as we continue to scale globally.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.


Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience leading and developing engineering teams in high-growth technology environments.

  • Strong technical background in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering, Information Security, or related domains.

  • Proven track record of building, scaling, and improving engineering teams, processes, and operational excellence.

  • Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and balancing strategic initiatives with day-to-day operational priorities.

  • Strong understanding of modern cloud-native architectures, infrastructure automation, observability, and security best practices.

  • Experience driving reliability, availability, and security improvements in production environments at scale.

  • Ability to partner effectively with Engineering, Product, and Business stakeholders and align technical initiatives with company goals.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions across all levels of the organisation.

  • Demonstrated experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineers and technical leaders.

  • Data-driven mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes, continuous improvement, and operational efficiency.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment where priorities can change quickly.

  • Fluent in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience leading teams across Platform Engineering, Internal IT, and Information Security functions.

  • Experience with compliance and security frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or GDPR-related initiatives.

  • Experience supporting globally distributed engineering organisations.

  • Previous experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS, marketplace, or travel technology company.

What you can expect

  • Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

  • Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

  • Built with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

  • Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com, Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

  • Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.

Our hiring team for this role:

Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov.

For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at (Come join us!
